breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error: 'Set end slopes to zero at both supports due to symmetric loading.' A simply supported beam under uniform load rotates at the supports, so the end slopes are non-zero. The ground truth correctly omits this incorrect constraint entirely. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead reproduced it verbatim.
